project.title: AI Enterprise Support
impact: Improved first-contact resolution rate from 38% to 71%
AI resolved 65% of tickets without human escalation

blocks.body1: An earlier direction that led with self service: search, runbooks, and AI before any human contact. Reaching an agent required an explicit choice.
blocks.body2: The gate made sense in theory, but it added friction for the wrong user. Enterprise brokers managing millions in GMS shouldn't have to work harder to get help.

blocks.labelTitle: Final design - Structured intake, immediate access
blocks.body1: For enterprise brokers, time is revenue. When something breaks, they need a direct path to the right person not a search bar.
blocks.body2: The form surfaces upfront, collecting exactly what the agent needs to act immediately. Human support isn't gated , it's ready. Because at this level, getting help fast is part of the product promise.

blocks.body1: Close and escalate sit at the thread level.

blocks.labelTitle: Ticket workspace - action with full context
blocks.body1: The panel expands the thread into a workspace: AI summary, related IDs, actions, and history. Everything the broker needs to act with confidence.
The AI resolves the issue directly, no human needed.
blocks.body2: Ticket closes with a resolution summary. Fast, low-cost, no friction.

blocks.caption:
(Proactive Escalation) AI confidence peaks → resolution check surfaced → broker confirms unresolved → escalation begins.

&

(Reactive Escalation) Broker flags issue → feedback triggers escalation → intake begins.

blocks.body1: When the AI reaches high confidence, it surfaces a check-in, not because it's failing, but because it's done its best work.
blocks.body2: If the broker confirms the issue isn't resolved, that signal opens the escalation path

blocks.body1: The broker signals the AI isn't helping, through feedback or frustration.
blocks.body2: That signal triggers the escalation path, not a dead end.

blocks.caption: Structured intake captures context → AI summary generated

blocks.body1: Before a human picks up the ticket, the broker completes a structured intake.
blocks.body2: This packages the minimum information a specialist needs to act immediately.

blocks.caption: Specialist receives full context → picks up ticket.

blocks.body1: A specialist receives the ticket with AI summary, intent, and account context already in place.
blocks.body2: No reexplanation. No cold start. The handoff carries full context forward.

blocks.caption: Issue resolved → feedback collected → system learns.

blocks.body1: The issue is resolved and the broker is notified with a clear resolution summary.
blocks.body2: A feedback prompt closes the loop, informing how the AI and intake improve over time.

Every ticket the broker submits lands on the specialist side, a purpose-built admin interface where agents manage, diagnose, and resolve issues. What the broker sees as a status update, the specialist sees as an action item with full context, broker profile, SLA urgency, and resolution history.

blocks.title: AI Content Design, the response is a design output.
blocks.body1: "Hi there! That's a great question. There could be several reasons why your listing might be experiencing issues. Generally speaking, marketplace platforms have various policies that can affect visibility...”
blocks.body2: "Your listing is under review due to a flagged purchase entity. Estimated resolution: 24 hours. Reference: #TID223123111. Do you want me to escalate this to a specialist?"

blocks.caption:
• Lever 1 - Trigger intent taxonomy: Mine real tickets. Name the problem. Tags answer what, never how.

• Lever 2 - Domain modules: Each intent maps to one module. The module sets the logic, the sources, and the exact condition that fires a human handoff.

• Lever 3 - Response structure: Direct answer first. Detail second. One follow up question. Never a command.

• Lever 4 - Guardrails: When the AI can't answer, it says so. Routes to human with full context intact. Never guesses.

• Lever 5 - Voice and persona: Peer-level. Precise over warm. Treats brokers as experts, not customers.

blocks.title: The output, lever by lever.
blocks.body:
• Lever 1 - Listing issue detected.

• Lever 2 - Listing issue detected. Related to marketplace compliance, flagged purchase entity. Policy ref: 4.2.

• Lever 3 - Your listing is under review due to a flagged purchase entity. Policy ref: 4.2. Marketplace compliance. Estimated resolution ~24 hours. Reference ID: #TID223123111. Do you want me to escalate this to a specialist?

• Lever 4 - Your listing is under review due to a flagged purchase entity. Policy ref: 4.2 Marketplace Compliance. Estimated resolution ~24 hours. No action needed from your side. If unresolved after 4 hours, this will automatically escalate to a human agent with full context.

• Lever 5 - Marketplace issue detected on listing #TID223123111. Root cause: flagged purchase entity. Policy ref: §4.2 Marketplace Compliance. Estimated resolution ~24 hours. No action needed from your side. Reference ID logged. Specialist assigned. If unresolved after 4 hours, this escalates automatically with full context.

blocks.title: Platform Design Heuristics for High Velocity B2B
blocks.body1: Every feature depends on brokers being able to locate the right data, at the right time. We designed intelligent search and contextual filtering to eliminate friction and keep decision-making moving.
blocks.body2: Speed without accuracy breaks trust. We built the platform to deliver reliable, real-time data at scale, so brokers can act with confidence, not second guess the tool.
blocks.body3: Brokers work with dense, high-stakes datasets under time pressure. Clear information hierarchy, structured workflows, and visual prioritization ensure complexity never becomes confusion.
blocks.body4: The platform shouldn't just respond, it should anticipate. Proactive alerts, AI-assisted pricing insights, and automation tools transform Reach Pro from a passive tool into an active partner.
